name: omarchy-ardoise
description: Minimalist task slate for the Omarchy Quattro bar: profiles, reminders, and archives.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:qml && npm run validate:plugin && npm test
scripts.test:docker: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work archlinux:latest bash -c 'echo "/usr/lib/qt6/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH" && export PATH="/usr/lib/qt6/bin:$PATH" && pacman -Sy --noconfirm git quickshell qt6-declarative deno jq && qmllint *.qml && deno check TodoStore.js && deno test --no-check --allow-read tests/ && jq -e . manifest.json'

author: tablerase
